name: Ōarai (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ōarai town emblem in white: a ring with a stylised device of two strokes and a disc, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ōarai, a town in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 1954.

features.role: Ōarai town emblem — a ring with a stylised device of two strokes and a disc, like a stylised character
